summary: Tested new POST /api/docx/read endpoint (structured Word extraction) and regression-tested POST /api/docx/to-pdf. All 7 pytest cases pass (100%). /api/docx/read correctly returns blocks with proper text/level/bold values (level=0 for body, 1..6 for headings, bold=true when level>0), correct paragraph_count=4 and char_count>0. Error cases (no auth 401, bad token 401, missing field 422, invalid base64 400, non-DOCX bytes 400) all return the expected status codes. /api/docx/to-pdf regression: response starts with %PDF-, and the 'pages' field equals fitz.open(...).page_count as required.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1978 lines — well past the 700-line threshold. Consider splitting the PDF/DOCX/AI toolkits into separate routers/modules for maintainability.

In /docx/read, if _decode_b64_bytes raises HTTPException(400) that's fine, but the DOCX open catches all Exception and returns 400 with the raw exception message truncated — acceptable but consider a more user-friendly message.
docstring for /docx/read says blocks are '{text, size, bold}' but response is actually '{text, level, bold}' — update docstring to match.
seed_data_creation: None persisted; DOCX bytes generated in-memory per test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Test file at /app/backend/tests/test_docx_endpoints.py covers both /api/docx/read (4 blocks assertion + 5 error cases) and /api/docx/to-pdf (happy path with pages == actual page_count). Reuses guest auth via /api/auth/guest. BASE_URL read strictly from EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL env (no default).
